name: 50 — Gateway Per-User Daily Cost Limit
description:
Tests Phase 4: Gateway per-user daily cost limiting. User has role 'viewer' with $5.00/day limit. Sends expensive requests to burn through budget and verify 402 error.

🔧 Gateway Config:
• Token: test-gateway-token-12345
• NO app assigned → Direct path (bypasses Temporal)
• Governance Profile: 'mock' (no gateway-level cost limits)
• Model: claude-sonnet-4-6 (expensive model)
  - Input: ~$3 per 1M tokens
  - Output: ~$15 per 1M tokens

👤 User Config:
• User: test-viewer (user_id from JWT)
• Role: viewer
• Rate Limit: 100 requests/minute
• Daily Cost Limit: $5.00/day (⚠️ LOW LIMIT)

🎯 Test Goal:
• Send requests with large context (high token count)
• Each request costs ~$0.50-1.00
• After ~5-10 requests, daily spend should hit $5.00
• Next request should fail with 402 (payment required)
• Verify cost tracked in gateway_requests.cost_usd
• Verify daily spend query works correctly

✅ Expected Behavior:
• First ~5-10 requests: 200 OK
• Once daily spend >= $5.00: 402 Payment Required
• Error message: "daily cost limit exceeded"
• Query: SELECT SUM(cost_usd) FROM gateway_requests WHERE user_id = X AND created_at >= today

📊 Success Criteria:
• Majority of requests succeed (70-90%)
• At least 1 request gets 402 error
• Error code: "quota_exceeded"
• No 500 errors (quota check must not crash)
• Cost tracking accurate in database

⚠️ Important:
• This test uses REAL LLM provider (not mock)
• Costs ~$5-10 to run
• Only run when testing cost enforcement
• Alternative: Use mock provider with synthetic cost_usd values

💡 Purpose: Validates Phase 4 cost limiting - prevents users from exceeding their role-based daily budget.
